```{=html}
<div id="map-aug03" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug03').setView([33.3300, 126.3500], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Grabel Hotel Jeju', lat:33.4996, lng:126.5312, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Grabel+Hotel+Jeju' },
    { name:'Yeomiji Botanical Garden 🌸', lat:33.3059, lng:126.3130, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Yeomiji+Botanical+Garden+Jeju' },
    { name:'Jeju Sun Buckwheat Noodles 🍜', lat:33.3100, lng:126.3200, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jeju+buckwheat+noodles+restaurant' },
    { name:'Osulloc Tea Museum 🍵', lat:33.3059, lng:126.2892, c:'#2E7D32', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Osulloc+Tea+Museum+Jeju' },
    { name:'Comma Cafe ☕', lat:33.3100, lng:126.2900, c:'#AB47BC', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Comma+cafe+Jeju+west' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

    <div class="event-name">Osulloc Tea Museum</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Korea's premier green tea museum set amid rolling tea plantations. The museum covers 4,000 years of Korean tea culture. Surrounded by Innisfree's green tea fields (same company). Must-try:
      <ul>
        <li>Osulloc green tea ice cream (삼다도 아이스크림)</li>
        <li>Fresh brewed premium green tea</li>
        <li>Tea field walk for photos</li>
      </ul>
      Free admission to museum grounds and gardens. In-store experiences cost extra.
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Osulloc+Tea+Museum+Jeju" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Osulloc</a>
